description: Assignment: an order whose collection day is not open for Own fleet (a Sunday: DayNotOpen), so Own fleet has nobody to drive it. Known answer: assign-carrier to the cheapest priced active Carrier, PakketPunt Express (CAR-0003, about 23% below the Shipper's Rate Card on the Lane against 20% and 16% for the others). Check the cost of each Carrier in the tool call if the seed's Carrier Rate Cards have changed.

setup.seed: Book a Transport Order as Brouwer Dranken from Rotterdam to Utrecht (6 pallets, 1800 kg) in the Partner portal and leave it unassigned, collecting on a Sunday. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Transport Order's number.

input: Suggest who should carry the Transport Order ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, with the reasoning and the trade-off against the other options.

explanation.rubric: Does not recommend Own fleet. Recommends the cheapest priced Carrier, quotes its cost as the result gives it and compares it with the other Carriers' costs.
